REJECTED after measurement (sq-56z). Both hot paths (build_raw_perms SPO-dedup + sibling perms; external_sort/spill_run tail) ALREADY use rayon par_sort_unstable under the default 'parallel' feature, not the serial sort_unstable the lever assumed. Best-effort MSD radix (incl. a load-balanced parallel variant that does parallel chunked histogram + par_sort_unstable fallback for big buckets) measured ~0.5-0.7x the throughput of plain par_sort_unstable on [u32;3] rows across 4 distributions (Wikidata-like / dense / small-chunk / POS-like low-leading-cardinality) -> a regression, no distribution where radix wins. Serial radix DOES beat the SERIAL sort_unstable (~1.3-2.0x) but no shipped path uses the serial sort. Root cause: radix scatter is a random-write memory shuffle == exactly the bandwidth-bound bottleneck the bead flagged; par_sort_unstable (parallel driftsort) is already cache-tuned. Verdict recorded in research/fast-ingestion.md lever #3 -> REJECTED with rationale. Decision: keep par_sort_unstable, do not add a radix path. (ratios measured on the non-canonical -aws work box; directional only.)
